systems.system: Universal Access and Service Fund broadband connectivity for schools
systems.tiers: primary schools, health clinics and tribal administration offices in remote and previously unserved areas; all public schools expected to have internet in the first half of the 2024-2029 plan

note: The excerpt of BOCRA's annual report for the year to March 2024 gives school connectivity only, which is enabling; it names no system holding learner records.
